message:
test(apk): the recovery episode and the D8 held / accepted points through the product session -- what the host receives (keepalive-r2 e, apk-decoder-inbox C r1)

android_decoder_inbox_session_test (new; the PRODUCT ClientSessionController -- UDP receive loop, control loop, limiter,
control over the video socket -- into the APK sink through its binding adapter, a fake host on loopback recording every
RequestKeyFrame it receives):
- [S1] a chain loss, the host answering no key request: the HOST receives exactly 4, at 0 / 1003 / 3011 / 7022 ms after
  the first (this run); the episode ends exhausted (recSent 4); control stays open (keepalive gap 56 ms); the host's
  next IDR is decoded and ends the state.
- [S2] D8 at the ACCEPTED point: another PC bound right before the exchange -- the request is not sent (the host
  receives none), KeyRequestsDroppedStale +1.
- [S3] D8 at the HELD point: the limiter (one token per 1.5 s) refuses the retry; another PC bound before it goes again
  -- dropped; the host receives only the first request, also after the limiter would have taken it.
9/9.

native_video_client_session.cpp/.hpp, TEST BUILDS ONLY (REMOTE60_CLIENT_SESSION_TEST_HOOKS; the APK and the product
builds do not define it): SetTestKeyRequestHook -- called at the held / accepted point right before the sink judges
the request, so a test puts the race exactly there; TestConfigureKeyframeLimiter -- the limiter's parameters, so a
test can make it refuse.

CMakeLists: the target; REMOTE60_INBOX_SESSION_SRC (the session source that test builds, a mutated copy in the
negative runs). decoder_chain_inbox_test includes its headers with <> so REMOTE60_CHAIN_INBOX_DIR (a mutated copy)
is taken before this file's own directory -- with "" MSVC found the src copy first and a header mutant's pure run
was not a mutant run.
